svg.text: Reset release and start-up code (cycles -5 to 30)
The first fetch is at cycle 2, address 0x01000080; the first data write at cycle 17 (address 0x1b4174, value 0).
blue line = signal (high or low), box = bus value in hex, dashed = not shown (request is 0), green = clock; cycle 0 = reset release
